goals.title: Lift the boulder off the cave with a crane your friends run
goals.pitch: Build a crane your friends run like a hamster wheel and lift the boulder that blocks the cave.
goals.play: A boulder far too heavy for anyone sits in the mouth of the cliff cave. You build a crane from wood and rope, a big wheel on an axle and a rope over pulleys, and the friends are its engine: each runs the wheel towards the food you hang in front of it (fish for Pinchy, berries for Truffle), a heavy friend turns it harder, a fed one stops, and every pulley you add makes the load lighter to pull but slower to come up. The boulder rises a hand's width at a time, the frame creaks and bends under it, and when a friend stops the load runs back and spins the wheel backwards unless you built a ratchet. You learn the numbers by feel: which friends together, how many pulleys, how thick a beam. Behind the cave are heavier things: the boat to lower into the bay, the bell to raise into its frame, each needing a bigger crane or a cleverer one.
goals.moment: The boulder is a metre up when Truffle spots a beetle and hops out; the boulder drops, the wheel whips backwards with Pinchy still sprinting inside it, and Pinchy shoots out of the wheel into the sand.
road: a stone on a rope over one, two and four pulleys, raised by a hand crank: the pull and the speed follow from the pulleys (rigid bodies and rope in PrintSim), filmed
the treadwheel: a friend runs it towards its food, by its own weight; fed, it stops; the load runs back and spins the wheel, or a ratchet holds it (film)
the boulder at the cave: the crane's beams bend under the load, pulleys and friends chosen in Jump in
the cave opens; the next loads (the boat, the bell) ask for bigger cranes
